title: Home Mortgage Loans: Term, Rate Type and Payment Calendar by Program
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Term, Rate Type and Payment Calendar by Program

This reference card gives, for each of the six programs offered under Home Mortgage Loans, the scheduled length of the loan, the kind of note rate it carries, the par rate Piedmont Crescent Bank currently publishes, how long a locked rate is honored, and the calendar on which installments come due.

## Meaning of each column

- **Term** — the scheduled life of the loan, expressed as a whole number of months.
- **Rate type** — the note rate is either fixed or adjustable.
- **Par rate** — the note rate presently published by the bank for a loan priced with no discount points and a 45-day lock, stated as an annual percentage.
- **Lock period** — the number of calendar days during which a locked rate remains honored ahead of closing.
- **First due offset** — how many calendar months after the month in which the loan funded the first installment becomes payable; that first installment falls on the first day of the month so reached.
- **Due day** — the day of each month on which an installment is owed.

## Schedule

| Program | Term (months) | Rate type | Par rate (%) | Lock period (calendar days) | First due offset (months after funding month) | Due day of month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 | fixed | 6.125 | 45 | 2 | 1 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 | fixed | 5.875 | 45 | 2 | 1 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 | fixed | 6.375 | 45 | 2 | 1 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 180 | fixed | 5.625 | 45 | 2 | 1 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 360 | adjustable | 5.990 | 45 | 2 | 1 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 | fixed | 6.500 | 45 | 2 | 1 |

## Reading the schedule

**Which program has an adjustable note rate?** Only the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage. The remaining five programs are fixed-rate.

**Which program runs for less than thirty years?** The Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, scheduled over 180 months; every other program is scheduled over 360 months.

**Does the lock period or the due-date calendar differ between programs?** No. All six programs honor a lock for 45 calendar days, place the first installment in the second calendar month after the funding month, and set the first of the month as the installment due day.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

Suppose, purely as an example, that a Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage funds on 18 September of some year. Counting two calendar months past September reaches November, so the first installment is owed on 1 November, and each later installment is owed on the first of each following month. The funding date chosen here is illustrative only; the same result follows for any program on this card, since all of them share the same offset and due day.
